mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in labor participation (PAYEMS) exceeding 1% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as it reflects expanded labor demand and corporate hiring optimism.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite PAYEMS rising > 1% in the month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month averages over 60 days amplifies economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS above their 12-month moving averages
failure_condition: The joint growth in GDPC1 and RSAFS does not consistently predict higher S&P 500 returns over 60 days (p > 0.05 in 3-year walk-forward test).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS < 2%), sustained declines in the federal funds rate signal accommodative policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the monetary easing cycle, FEDFUNDS < 2% does not lead to significantly higher 20-day returns than a control period (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) above their 12-month averages over 20 days strengthens economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Simultaneous growth in GDPC1 and INDPRO does not consistently predict positive returns over 20 days (p > 0.05 in 3-year test).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) crossing above 110 triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as it signals supply-side expansion and corporate investment.
failure_condition: INDPRO crossing above 110 does not result in significantly positive 5-day returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% over 60 days indicates labor market strengthening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate does not fall below 3.5% over 60 days, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, rising demand (HOUST) and high GDP (GDPC1) above their 12-month averages over 20 days signal peak economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST above their 12-month moving averages
failure_condition: During late-cycle expansion, GDPC1 and HOUST above moving averages do not consistently predict positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05 in 3-year test).
